legalDocument.title: Privacy & Data Protection
legalDocument.heading: Privacy and Personal Data Protection
legalDocument.introduction: It is important to understand how your personal data is handled while using Sportner. This draft is here to demonstrate the consent flow until the final agreements are ready.

data.title: 1. What information do we collect?
data.body: We process the name, username, email address, birth date and profile preferences you provide to deliver the service, keep your account secure and personalize your sports experience.

usage.title: 2. How do we use your information?
usage.body: We use your information to manage your account, show your events and attendance, communicate with you and improve the app. Optional marketing communications will always have a separate preference.

sharing.title: 3. Who do we share your information with?
sharing.body: We only share information with technical providers needed to run the service and with competent authorities when legally required. We do not sell personal data.

rights.title: 4. What are your rights?
rights.body: You can request access to, correction or deletion of your data and information about its processing. Once the agreements are published, this section will include contact channels and the full process.
